text_description: A tailored burgundy skirt suit worn over a pale cream/ivory underlayer, shown from head to upper legs. The cropped jacket has a structured, close-cut silhouette with narrow shoulders, long sleeves, and a large pointed spread collar in solid burgundy. The body and sleeves are covered in a small allover geometric check/dot pattern in pale blue-white against burgundy, with solid burgundy trim defining the front edges, pocket bands, hem, cuffs, and collar. The jacket is worn open enough to reveal a pale shirting layer underneath, whose longer rounded hem extends below the jacket and sits over the top of the matching skirt. Gold-tone buttons run down the jacket front, and multiple horizontal pocket details or bands sit across the chest and lower front. The sleeve cuffs are turned back slightly, exposing a light grey/pale lining and solid burgundy cuff tabs. The matching skirt continues the same burgundy micro-pattern and appears slim and straight, creating a coordinated, polished suit silhouette with the jacket cropped above the hips and the underlayer visibly breaking the waistline. Accessories include a chunky gold chain necklace at the open neckline, small light-toned earrings, and a small handbag held at the side with a pale blue strap and burgundy body. The overall styling is refined, structured, and ladylike, with a rich burgundy palette contrasted by pale cream, light blue-grey patterning, and gold hardware accents.
